span.p:
pc reg, 8 bits
rst → 0
pc_en → pc_jmp ? operand : pc + 1

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
imem ROM
N × 16 bits
word = imem[pc]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
decode
opcode = word[15:13]
delay = word[12:8]
operand = word[7:0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tx_fifo
8 bits × depth
tx_push → append
pull_en → drop head

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
shift_dir reg, 1 bit
rst → 0 (LSB first)
dir_en → operand[0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
shift_reg reg, 8 bits
rst → 0
pull_en → fifo_head
shift_en → shift_dir ?
{shift_reg[6:0], 1'b0} : {1'b0, shift_reg[7:1]}
shift_bit = shift_dir ?
shift_reg[7] : shift_reg[0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
gpio reg, 4 bits
rst → 4'b1111
shift_en → gpio[0] ← shift_bit
gpio_en → gpio[pin] ← operand[0]
pin = operand[5:4]
(SHIFT_OUT's side effect fires both:
its pin is never 0)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
in_shift_reg reg, 8 bits
rst → 0
shift_in_en → shift_dir ?
{in_shift_reg[6:0], in_bit} : {in_bit, in_shift_reg[7:1]}
in_bit = gpio_in[operand[3:2]]
(sampled at the same edge
a side effect writes gpio)
